## Problem

Describe the concrete problem this change addresses.

## Change

Describe the resulting behavior and any important implementation decisions.

## Validation

List the checks you actually ran and their results. For a visible change, include a screenshot when useful. State anything relevant that remains unverified.

## Compatibility and dependencies

Note any effect on existing environments, engine requirements, dependencies, or third-party licenses. Write "not applicable" if there is no such change.
